rust_summary:
a dedicated server's new world for a mod's own `level-type`
(`native_level_type_world_gen`).
doc_summary:
`native_level_type_world_gen(dir, level_type, seed, structures, written)`, a dedicated server's new world
before it writes `world_gen_settings` from server.properties: vanilla's `level-type` names any world preset, so a mod
whose preset it names writes the world's settings (and its data pack) into `dir` and sets `written`; left `None`,
vanilla's presets apply as before. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:level_type_world_gen@`.
